_note: Single source of truth for the website roadmap section (index.html, between the roadmap markers) and the 'What features are coming soon?' help answer (docs/help/18). Groups: live = Live now, next = In progress, later = Coming next. Edit here, then run: npm run build:roadmap && npm run build:support-kb. No dates, ever. 'match' lists lowercase phrases used by verify:roadmap to tie each 'Coming soon' pill on the site (and each industries page marked Coming soon) to an item here.

live.title: Upload and bulk import
live.text: Add PDFs, photos, Word, Excel and CSV files one at a time, or drop in a whole folder or a .zip.

live.title: Automatic sorting and field reading
live.text: Every page is read, sorted by kind and filed, with names, dates, amounts and serial numbers pulled out for you.

live.title: Inbox with "Needs you"
live.text: Anything DeepWell could not settle on its own waits in one short list, with a plain reason.

live.title: Smarter Inbox
live.text: More kinds of paperwork recognized, copies and voided documents set aside, and every sort previewed before you confirm. New in 1.3.

live.title: Records and customer profiles
live.text: Browse by document or by customer and see every visit, invoice and warranty for one customer in one place.

live.title: Ask Donovan, with sources
live.text: Ask a plain-English question and get an answer with the original page attached as the source.

live.title: "Did you mean" for names and addresses
live.text: Misspell a customer name or an address and Donovan offers the closest match instead of coming up empty.

live.title: Voice questions
live.text: Tap the mic and ask Donovan your question out loud.

live.title: Phone app
live.text: Scan paperwork on your phone, even with no signal; pages upload when it returns.

live.title: Office and field views
live.text: A calm dark view for the office, or switch to light, larger type for working outdoors.

live.title: Warranty tracking and export
live.text: See which coverage is expiring across every unit and export warranty records any time.

live.title: Team accounts
live.text: Invite your team, each with their own login.

live.title: Plans and billing
live.text: Pick a plan, change it and manage billing from inside DeepWell.

live.title: API access
live.text: Connect your own systems to DeepWell on the Fleet plan.

live.title: Industry demo
live.text: Pick from 43 industries and watch your kind of paperwork get uploaded, organized and answered.

live.title: Help chat
live.text: Ask the help chat how DeepWell works, any time, with answers drawn from our public help articles.

live.title: Public status page
live.text: See whether DeepWell is up right now, and past incidents, at status.deepwelltechnology.com.

next.title: Donovan answers more, in every industry
next.text: More of your questions answered directly from your records, whatever your line of work, always with the source.

next.title: Automatic encrypted backups
next.text: Your customer files copied on a schedule, encrypted, to a separate location.

next.title: Google Drive import
next.text: Choose files and folders in your Google Drive and DeepWell brings them in and reads them.

later.title: Donovan for every industry on the dashboard
later.text: Ask Donovan right from your dashboard, tuned to your industry.

later.title: Deeper Google Drive sync
later.text: Connect a Drive folder once and new files come in on their own.

later.title: One-click restore
later.text: Bring back a company's files from a backup in one click.

later.title: Email and folder upload
later.text: Forward a vendor invoice or drop files in a folder and they file themselves.

later.title: Branch scoping
later.text: Limit each person to the records of their own branch or location.

later.title: Callback analytics
later.text: See which technicians and equipment brands generate the most repeat visits.

later.title: Uptime SLA
later.text: An uptime commitment with service credits.
